description_en: Retrieves a join permission owned by the current user account based on the join permission ID
description_zh: 根据入网凭证ID获取当前用户账号所拥有的入网凭证
name: GetOwnedJoinPermission

parameters.help_en: The ID of the join permission to retrieve
parameters.name: join_permission_id

Data.description_en: The information about the join permission
Data.description_zh: 所拥有入网凭证的信息列表

AuthState.description_en:
The authorization state of the join permission. Valid values:

NEW: Not authorized.
APPLYING: Authorization in progress.
ACCEPTED: Authorized
AuthState.description_zh:
入网凭证的授权状态。取值：

NEW：未授权
APPLYING：授权中
ACCEPTED：已授权

ClassMode.description_en: The LoRaWAN Class mode used by the join permission. Valid values: A, B, and C
ClassMode.description_zh: 入网凭证采用的LoRaWAN Class模式。取值：A、B、C

CreateMillis.description_en: The time when the join permission was created. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
CreateMillis.description_zh: 入网凭证的创建时间。格式为 UNIX 时间戳，单位毫秒

DataDispatchDestination.description_en:
The data dispatch destination. Valid values:

IOT: Data is forwarded to an IoT Platform product.
ONS: Data is forwarded to a Message Queue topic
DataDispatchDestination.description_zh:
数据流转目的地。取值：

IOT：数据流转到IoT的产品。
ONS：数据流转到MQ的Topic

Enabled.description_en: Indicates whether the join permission is enabled
Enabled.description_zh: 入网凭证的启停用状态

FreqBandPlanGroupId.description_en: The frequency band ID used by the join permission
FreqBandPlanGroupId.description_zh: 入网凭证所采用的频段的频段ID

JoinEui.description_en: The JoinEUI used by the join permission

JoinPermissionName.description_en: The name of the join permission

MulticastEnabled.description_en: Indicates whether multicast is enabled for the join permission
MulticastEnabled.description_zh: 入网凭证组播的启停用状态

MulticastNodeCapacity.description_en: The maximum number of multicast nodes that can be added to the join permission
MulticastNodeCapacity.description_zh: 入网凭证可接入组播节点容量

MulticastNodeCount.description_en: The number of multicast nodes that have been added to the join permission
MulticastNodeCount.description_zh: 入网凭证已接入组播节点数量

NodesCnt.description_en: The number of nodes that use the join permission
NodesCnt.description_zh: 使用该入网凭证的节点的数量

RenterAliyunId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the join permission tenant
RenterAliyunId.description_zh: 入网凭证租户的阿里云账号ID

RxDailySum.description_en: The number of uplink data packets of the join permission on the current day
RxDailySum.description_zh: 入网凭证的当天上行数据包量

RxDelay.description_en: The receive window delay for Class A

RxMonthSum.description_en: The number of uplink data packets of the join permission in the current month
RxMonthSum.description_zh: 入网凭证的当月上行数据包量

TxDailySum.description_en: The number of downlink data packets of the join permission on the current day
TxDailySum.description_zh: 入网凭证的当天下行数据包量

TxMonthSum.description_en: The number of downlink data packets of the join permission in the current month
TxMonthSum.description_zh: 入网凭证的当月下行数据包量

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
